question: Limits of archive/manual-action/security evidence in existing expired-domain portfolio selection

sources.title: Google Search spam policies
facts: Expired-domain abuse definition includes primarily ranking manipulation and little/no user value
Policy enforcement can involve automated systems and human review
sources.limit: Not a determination about any owned or candidate domain

sources.title: Manual actions report
facts: Report covers manual actions and history
Recent purchase does not remove listed issues; remediate and request review
Review can take days/weeks or longer
sources.limit: No actual Search Console report opened; no claim about automated ranking signals

sources.title: Security issues report
facts: Security issues have a separate report
Example URLs need not be complete
Failure to reproduce a warning in a browser is not sufficient to clear it
sources.limit: No affected URLs, browser warnings or owner property inspected
